decisions.note: Keep the allowed tags, derived tag type, meme shape, and keyed meme records together in one readonly TypeScript registry so invalid tags fail type-checking.
Use vanilla TypeScript, HTML, and CSS with Vite for the single-page meme browser; avoid a component framework until the product needs one.
Route *.node.test.ts and *.jsdom.test.ts unit tests to their named Vitest environments, and reserve *.e2e.test.ts for repository-level Playwright tests in Chromium.
Keep main.ts as the browser composition root and place gallery markup, state, events, clipboard handling, and cleanup in one meme-browser controller.
Declare type-only imports explicitly on separate import statements and sort them before value imports.
Use the stable native TypeScript 7 compiler and language server; do not retain the native-preview package or legacy tsserver workspace configuration.
